A new era in rheometry begins with the instrument carrying the DNA of Anton Paar’s flagship MCR series. Welcome to the next generation of entry-level instruments, inspired by more than a decade of innovation.
Designed for speed, intelligence, and trust, they deliver the fastest measurements, and the highest reproducibility. They’re effortless to operate due to touchscreen operation, digital leveling, and TruRay illumination. And the CoolPeltier system ensures precise, cost-efficient temperature control without thermostats. With automatic calibration, verification tools, and full support, these instruments redefine entry-level rheometry.  
Key features
The fastest entry-level rheometer
Experience the fastest entry-level rheometer on the market, delivering standard measurements up to 60 % faster compared to any other comparable rheometer. Features like the Trimming Mirror and TruRay Illumination simplify and accelerate sample preparation. And QuickConnect and Toolmaster ensure instant, tool-free setup and automatic accessory recognition. This way, you get precision and efficiency in every test.
The most precise temperature control in entry-level rheometry
Achieve the most precise temperature control in entry-level rheometry with CoolPeltier technology (no thermostat required), reducing costs and environmental impact. The gradient-free range from -5 °C to +200 °C ensures unmatched accuracy, while automatic calibration sets cover -50 °C to +400 °C for consistent precision. Compact, sustainable, and more capable than the competition, it delivers reliable results with lower investment and operational costs.
The smartest entry-level rheometer
The smartest entry-level rheometer features an integrated touchscreen. Guided testing allows complete test setup, sample preparation, and operation directly on the instrument. Auto Control continuously monitors the sample behavior during tests and adjusts the control loop in real time – automatically delivering high-quality results even for unknown samples. This eliminates the need for time-consuming preset adjustments, and ensures effortless precision every time.

The most adaptable entry-level rheometer
The most adaptable entry-level rheometer sets new standards in flexibility, with modularity that expands from core QC applications to advanced areas like powder rheology and tribology with the MCR 93. With its ball-bearing design, the MCR 53 operates without pressurized air, offering maximum flexibility for use even next to production lines. Built to adapt and grow with your testing needs, it delivers reliable performance today and is fully equipped for the future.
The most trusted entry-level rheometer
The most trusted entry-level rheometer combines Anton Paar’s pioneering legacy with state-of-the-art MCR technology for unmatched reliability and precision. RheoCompass for QC features the industry’s largest library of guided templates and SOPs – simplifying every step of your workflow. With configurable My Apps and expert support, it delivers consistent, confident results for every user and application. Our unique digital leveling system replaces traditional water balances with smart software control, making setup faster and more precise. The leveling status is automatically stored with each data set, so you can always verify correct alignment later – ensuring full confidence in results.

Welcome to the MCR series: A new era in rheometry
The exciting new rheometers – MCR 303, MCR 503, and MCR 503 Power – are based on new modular platform architecture, enabling outstanding measurement quality and ease of use to ensure excellent reproducibility and remarkable productivity. With a wide range of configurations available, including the option to transform the modular compact rheometer into a material characterization platform, the MCR series is ready to meet all your current and future requirements. 
Key features
The most precise rheometer
The most precise rheometer to date, the new MCR enables previously unthinkable applications and enhances every measurement.
Unmatched minimum torque of 0.15 nNm in oscillation
Exclusive high-frequency data: Up to 255 Hz
Breakthrough normal force accuracy of 1 mN
Stable motor: Drift-free high-precision measurements over weeks
Fastest electronics: Monitor even the quickest curing reactions
Best-in-class thermal stability: Eliminates temperature gradients in large solids
The fastest rheometer
With an unprecedented focus on productivity, the new MCR rheometer helps you increase output for a quicker return on investment.
TruChirp mode for rapid broadband frequency sweeps 
Next-generation electronics: Delivers results up to 60 % faster
Quick boot time: Starts in 6 seconds; 7× faster than other systems
QuickConnect: Mount measuring systems in seconds with one hand
TruRay and trimming mirror for precise sample preparation
With fastest global support: 35+ subsidiaries and experts help at no cost
More than instruments: Complete solutions from one trusted source
The smartest rheometer
Let the new, intelligent MCR take work off your hands, so you can focus on things that really matter.
Touchscreen: Sample preparation and testing directly at the instrument
Guided testing: Run and interact with measurements on the touchscreen
Electronic leveling: Prevent errors from improper setup
Automatic temperature calibration: From -160 °C to +600 °C
Sustainability: 56 % less energy use with air Peltier systems
Sample-adaptive controller: No manual presetting needed
Toolmaster: Automatic detection of tools and accessories
Auto gap control: Compensates for thermal expansion
The most adaptable rheometer
With the broadest accessory range available, you'll be able to realize whatever great ideas you have in the decades ahead.
7,000+ geometries: Cover every material, surface, and shape
40+ temperature devices: From -170 °C to +1,000 °C
Multiparameter options: Add pressure, humidity, voltage, and more
RheoOptics and structure analysis: Rheo-Raman, impedance, and more
Extended applications: Analyze interfaces, powders, bitumen, and more
Customized solutions: If it's not in our portfolio, we'll build it for you
More than a rheometer: A characterization platform
Learn with us: Webinars, books, and the Rheo Academy
The ultimate rheometer software
RheoCompass is accessible for everyone, with a new user interface and touchscreen for quick instrument operation. From routine QC testing to scientific applications, it’s ready for any challenge.
Touchscreen interface with intuitive navigation and multilingual support
250+ predefined templates with guided touch control
Customizable templates, extensive analysis tools, and pharma compliance
Specialized analysis for tribology, powder rheology, and LAOS data
More than just a rheometer
Our modular compact rheometers go beyond rheology – they are powerful characterization platforms for a wide range of applications, including tribology, powder analysis, dynamic mechanical analysis, and mechanical testing.
Powder testing: High-sensitivity powder behavior analysis
MCR Tribometer: Expanded tribological testing, including measurements of breakaway force and Stribeck curves
Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA): Deep insights into material properties such as modulus, damping, creep, glass transition temperatures, and more
Mechanical testing: Texture and material testing with high precision – from peel and puncture tests to compression and flexure analysis

The SmartMelt series is the choice for polymer melt rheology at the highest level. Experience unmatched performance, precise temperature control via actual sample temperature measurement, comprehensive shear rheology testing, and seamless compliance with ASTM D4440 and ISO 6721.
Designed for efficiency, SmartMelt ensures quick training, fast measurements, and dependable outcomes.
Key features
Comprehensive polymer melt rheology beyond one-point measurements
In contrast to one-point measurements such as the Melt Flow Index (MFI), the SmartMelt series determines the full shear-rheological picture, including flow curve, oscillation, time-temperature superposition (TTS), creep tests, relaxation tests. Easy-to-perform characterization enables reliable quality control and helps define optimal processing windows for manufacturing. The SmartMelt polymer melt rheometers are designed with modularity in mind, and measuring systems and other accessories can be exchanged to fit all of your needs. The series also complies with ASTM D4440 and ISO 6721.
Unparalleled temperature precision at an affordable price
The renowned Anton Paar ETD is the most cost-effective and high-performing electrical temperature oven for a polymer melt rheometer on the market. Covering a range of -150 °C to +400 °C, it offers direct temperature measurement at the sample, and minimizes temperature loss during loading and trimming while the sample is still in controlled inert atmosphere. The temperature calibration kit for automatic calibration ensures 100 % reliable results. 
Fast training, reliable results
A series of tools optimizes time-to-measurement and delivers reliable polymer melt rheology results, while reducing training time for operators:
Touchscreen: Full sample preparation and running of tests directly at the instrument 
TruChirp mode: Rapid broadband frequency sweeps using a controller-based OWCh approach 
Toolmaster: Automatic recognition of measuring geometry and cell
QuickConnect: One-handed coupling of the measuring geometry in seconds
RheoCompass templates: Pre-prepared measuring workflows
Sample preparation and cleaning tools
Save energy, reduce noise, and maximize precision
The resource-friendly SmartMelt series ensures cost savings and environmental sustainability by using minimal compressed gas and energy, while maintaining quiet operation for a better working environment. The option to use inert gas prevents sample degradation, thereby optimizing results for your critical applications. This combination of efficiency, precision, and sample protection makes SmartMelt the ideal choice for polymer melt rheology.
